description: Normalized (0–100) float value for the stock’s Smart Holdings score within its country
Normalized (float, 0–100) global rank of the Change Component, representing recent changes (momentum) in ownership signals for the stock globally
Normalized (0–100) float percentile rank of the stock’s Smart Holdings score globally. Higher value = higher likelihood of institutional ownership worldwide
Normalized (0–100) float value measuring global peer crowding/risk, where higher values indicate higher global institutional ownership. This is a reversal score: high = high crowding risk
Normalized (0–100) float value indicating the stock's style-fit or screening component, globally, adjusted for peer characteristics. Higher values suggest stronger global style fit
Normalized (0–100) float value representing the stock’s Smart Holdings score within its industry
Country rank (1–100) of Smart Holdings score. Higher rank = higher likelihood of institutional ownership within that country
Global rank (1–100) for the momentum or recent change component, representing the degree of recent increase in institutional ownership likelihood compared to global peers
Global rank (1–100) of peer crowding/capacity risk. 100 = highest global institutional ownership (most crowded), 1 = lowest. Indicates liquidity/capacity risk from peer positions
Global rank (1–100) of Smart Holdings model score. Higher ranks imply greater probability of global institutional ownership

Global rank (1–100) of the stock’s style-fit or screening component, adjusted for peer characteristics. Higher values represent better alignment with factors favored by institutional investors worldwide
Industry rank (1–100) of Smart Holdings score. Higher rank means higher probability of institutional ownership within that industry
Regional rank (1–100) indicating the strength of recent change or momentum in institutional ownership within the region

Regional rank (1–100) of Smart Holdings score. Higher rank = higher likelihood of institutional ownership within the region
Regional rank (1–100) of the stock’s style-fit or screening component, peer-adjusted. Higher rank suggests stronger regional style fit
Sector rank (1–100) of Smart Holdings score. Higher values represent higher expected institutional ownership in that sector
Normalized (float, 0–100) regional rank of the Change Component, representing momentum in institutional ownership signals at the region level
